notes.title: DUMB FIGHT release announcement!
notes.notes:
Early access by  7 Jan 20:00 (UTC-8)

Even though there are more to improve, we still want to release earlier, if you encounter any confusion or error, please do not hesitate to contact us on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1054720/discussions/]Steam discussion[/url] or mail to 
 sou@mogingames.com , we will try our best to solve the issue.

We will also continue to optimize during the early access period, and expanding content. We are welcome to listen to your advice and interesting thoughts on our Discord channel: 
 discord.gg/nmnGyxU  
DUMB FIGHT needs your engagement to become a better game.

Very much appreciate your support, we hope you like DUMB FIGHT.
